name: FrameClock

test_list.description: A fresh animated clock returns Some(0.0) on the first call.
Elapsed time below the step returns None until the accumulator reaches the step.
Each returned frame advances simulation time by exactly one step.
While hidden advance returns None and simulation time does not move; becoming visible resumes from the same time and requests a repaint.
A 5 s stall yields exactly one step, and the next short call yields None.
Reduced motion returns Some(STATIC_T) once and then None.
After invalidate the next advance returns Some even in reduced motion or when less than a step has elapsed, without advancing time.
Zero and absurdly large steps are clamped into the allowed range.

inputs.name: reduced_motion
inputs.description: Whether the user asked for reduced motion.

inputs.name: elapsed
inputs.description: Wall time since the previous advance call.

output_description: Some(simulation time in seconds) when a repaint is due, otherwise None.
